_about: Frozen v1/pre-6b baseline for the 5-video montage 'watch' set (scripts/batch_phase_b.py briefs). Cheap regression instrument until Step 7's eval harness exists. Scores are 1-5 eyeball (5=ship, target 4). REGRESSION = a 6b montage video scoring below its baseline here.
_score_provenance: Per-video baseline scores were not recorded. The only record of the first 5-video validation batch is an aggregate judgement of ~2/5 overall (composition good, execution weak: gradients, off-voice clips, repetition), so the aggregate stands in as the baseline for every video. The 2026-05-30 robustness test used a different brief set (Bolt/Boeing/Shaq/GameStop/Tiger) and is not comparable.
